commands.title: View LaTeX PDF in VS Code

vscode-fortex.mainFileOrder.markdownDescription: Priority order used to find the main LaTeX file: `magic` reads `%#main`, `guess` searches ancestor directories for a document that recursively includes the current file, and `current` uses the current file.

vscode-fortex.compileTrigger.description: Trigger for compiling the LaTeX document.

enumDescriptions: Open PDFs in the VS Code internal viewer.
vscode-fortex.pdfViewer.markdownDescription: PDF viewer used by **View LaTeX PDF** (`Ctrl+T P`). Select `internal` for the VS Code viewer or `sumatra` for SumatraPDF.

vscode-fortex.openPdfAfterBuild.description: Open the configured PDF viewer after a successful build. An already open internal preview is always refreshed.

vscode-fortex.sumatraPDF.path.markdownDescription: Full path to `SumatraPDF.exe`, for example `C:\Program Files\SumatraPDF\SumatraPDF.exe`. Leave empty to detect a standard installation or use `PATH`.

vscode-fortex.sumatraPDF.args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to SumatraPDF.

vscode-fortex.sumatraPDF.inverseSearch.e.description: Enable inverse SyncTeX search from SumatraPDF back to VS Code.

vscode-fortex.sumatraPDF.inverseSearch.v.markdownDescription: Path to the VS Code executable used by SumatraPDF inverse search. Leave empty to use the currently running VS Code executable. The generated command is `"<path>" -r -g "%f:%l"`.

vscode-fortex.synctex.path.description: SyncTeX command used for forward and reverse search.

enumDescriptions: Keep focus in the source editor after forward search.
Move focus to the PDF viewer after forward search.
vscode-fortex.synctex.forwardSearch.focu.markdownDescription: Focus destination after **SyncTeX from Cursor** (`Ctrl+T J`). Applies to both the internal viewer and SumatraPDF.

vscode-fortex.kpsewhich.path.description: kpsewhich command used to resolve bibliography files through the Kpathsea search path.

vscode-fortex.environment.indentContent.markdownDescription: Indent content by one editor indentation level when Fortex inserts or wraps a LaTeX environment. The indentation width and tabs/spaces follow the standard `editor.tabSize` and `editor.insertSpaces` settings.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
